text: Merleau-Ponty explains the phantom limb by appeal to the body schema, which he understands as:
choices: An accurate internal snapshot of the body's current anatomical state
A practical, action-oriented grasp of bodily possibilities that can persist unupdated after amputation
A purely physiological reflex arc in the spinal cord
A Cartesian ego issuing commands to a mechanical body
explanation: The body schema is a practical, action-oriented grasp of what the body can do, not an accurate anatomical snapshot; the phantom limb persists because this action-schema has not updated to the amputation. Merleau-Ponty rejects both the purely physiological (reflex-arc) and the Cartesian ego-commanding-a-machine pictures.
